mapper.select: SELECT BUSINESS_NAME,EMPLOYER_NO FROM EMPLOYER WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND BUSINESS_DEL_FL ='N'

SELECT A.EMPLOYER_NO AS EMPLOYER_NO, B.MEMBERSHIP_NO AS MEMBERSHIP_NO, B.MEMBERSHIP_TYPE AS MEMBERSHIP_TYPE, B.MEMBERSHIP_START_DATE AS MEMBERSHIP_START_DATE, B.MEMBERSHIP_END_DATE AS MEMBERSHIP_END_DATE, B.MEMBERSHIP_DEL_FL AS MEMBERSHIP_DEL_FL, (TRUNC(B.MEMBERSHIP_END_DATE) - TRUNC(B.MEMBERSHIP_START_DATE)) AS REMAINING_DAYS, (SELECT C.MEMBERSHIP_NAME FROM MEMBERSHIP_LEVEL C WHERE C.MEMBERSHIP_NO = B.MEMBERSHIP_TYPE) AS MEMBERSHIP_NAME FROM EMPLOYER A JOIN MEMBERSHIP B ON A.EMPLOYER_NO = B.EMPLOYER_NO WHERE A.EMPLOYER_NO = #{employerNo} AND B.MEMBERSHIP_DEL_FL = 'N'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(C.PAYMENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS PAYMENT_DATE, C.PAYMENT_NO AS PAYMENT_NO, C.PAYMENT_PRODUCT AS PAYMENT_PRODUCT, C.PAYMENT_AMOUNT AS PAYMENT_AMOUNT, C.PAYMENT_STATUS AS PAYMENT_STATUS, D.PAYMENT_TYPE_AMOUNT AS PAYMENT_TYPE_AMOUNT, D.PAYMENT_TYPE_PRODUCT AS PAYMENT_TYPE_PRODUCT, TO_CHAR(D.PAYMENT_TYPE_CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS PAYMENT_TYPE_CREATE_DATE FROM EMPLOYER E JOIN MEMBERSHIP A ON E.EMPLOYER_NO = A.EMPLOYER_NO JOIN PAYMENT_MEMBERSHIP B ON A.MEMBERSHIP_NO = B.MEMBERSHIP_NO JOIN PAYMENT C ON B.PAYMENT_NO = C.PAYMENT_NO JOIN PAYMENT_TYPE D ON C.PAYMENT_NO = D.PAYMENT_NO WHERE E.EMPLOYER_NO = #{employerNo} ) T ORDER BY T.PAYMENT_DATE DESC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO PAYMENT ( PAYMENT_NO, PAYMENT_DATE, PAYMENT_PRODUCT, PAYMENT_AMOUNT, PAYMENT_STATUS, MERCHANT_UID, IMP_UID ) VALUES ( SEQ_PAYMENT_NO.NEXTVAL, SYSDATE, #{paymentProduct}, #{paymentAmount}, #{paymentStatus}, #{merchantUid}, #{impUid} )
SELECT SEQ_PAYMENT_NO.CURRVAL FROM DUAL

INSERT INTO PAYMENT_MEMBERSHIP ( PAYMENT_MEMBERSHIP_NO, MEMBERSHIP_NO, PAYMENT_NO, PAYMENT_MEMBERSHIP_CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_PAYMENT_MEMBERSHIP_NO.NEXTVAL, #{membershipNo}, #{paymentNo}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO PAYMENT_TYPE ( PAYMENT_TYPE_NO, PAYMENT_TYPE_AMOUNT, PAYMENT_TYPE_PRODUCT, PAYMENT_TYPE_COUNT, PAYMENT_TYPE_CREATE_DATE, PAYMENT_NO ) VALUES ( SEQ_PAYMENT_TYPE_NO.NEXTVAL, #{membershipAmount}, #{membershipProduct}, #{membershipDateValue}, SYSDATE, #{paymentNo} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBERSHIP WHERE MEMBERSHIP_DEL_FL = 'N' AND EMPLOYER_NO = #{employerNo} AND (MEMBERSHIP_TYPE = 2 OR MEMBERSHIP_TYPE = 3)
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBERSHIP SET MEMBERSHIP_DEL_FL = 'Y' WHERE MEMBERSHIP_DEL_FL = 'N' AND EMPLOYER_NO = #{employerNo} AND MEMBERSHIP_TYPE = 2
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO MEMBERSHIP ( MEMBERSHIP_NO, MEMBERSHIP_TYPE, MEMBERSHIP_START_DATE, MEMBERSHIP_END_DATE, MEMBERSHIP_BUY_DATE, MEMBERSHIP_DEL_FL, EMPLOYER_NO ) VALUES ( SEQ_MEMBERSHIP_NO.NEXTVAL, #{membershipType}, SYSDATE, NVL(( SELECT MEMBERSHIP_END_DATE FROM MEMBERSHIP WHERE EMPLOYER_NO = #{employerNo} AND MEMBERSHIP_TYPE = 2 AND MEMBERSHIP_DEL_FL = 'N' ), SYSDATE) + CASE WHEN #{durationUnit} = 'MONTH' THEN 30 * #{membershipDateValue} WHEN #{durationUnit} = 'DAY' THEN #{membershipDateValue} END, SYSDATE, 'N', #{employerNo} )
SELECT SEQ_MEMBERSHIP_NO.CURRVAL FROM DUAL
